extracted.name: Rhonda’s Chicken and Sausage Gumbo
ingredient_lines: 1 package (10 oz) Frozen sliced okra, thawed (optional)
as needed for serving Hot cooked rice
instruction_lines: Cook flour in a Dutch oven over medium heat, stirring constantly, for 10 minutes or until golden. Remove flour from Dutch oven.
Coat Dutch oven with cooking spray. Sauté sausage over medium-high heat.
Add onions, celery, bell pepper, garlic, and ground red pepper; sauté 5 minutes.
Add chicken and sauté 3 minutes. Stir in flour until blended.
Gradually add chicken broth and tomatoes. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 30 minutes.
Add shrimp and okra (if using); simmer 20 minutes.
Serve gumbo over hot cooked rice. Garnish with fresh celery leaves if desired.
